If the second house from Upārūḍha is in its debilitated portion, joined by a debilitated planet, and conjoined with a malefic planet, the native will be a destroyer of his wife. || 8 ||
If [the lord of the seventh house] is in its own exaltation degree, or situated in its exaltation sign, or likewise by virtue of an exaltation aspect,
there will be many wives endowed with beauty and auspicious marks.
O Brahmin, when the second sign has ascended or when a Gemini is situated there, the man born therein will be possessed of many wives.
O Brāhmaṇa, even when the second [ascendant] has ascended, conjoined with its own lord's planet,
or when its lord is situated in its own sign, wherever that may be.
O best of the twice-born, that man in whose birth this yoga occurs will certainly be without a wife in the latter part of his life; of this there is no doubt.

Even when the lord of the house of marriage is situated thus in its own sign during the period known as Nitya, one will certainly be without a wife in the latter part of life; of this there is no doubt. (13)

If the husband-planet is situated in its exaltation or is the dispositor of a fixed sign, there will be the acquisition of a wife from a noble family; however, if it is in its fall, the opposite occurs.
O twice-born one, when the second [sign] has ascended, for one born through a connection with auspiciousness, there will be a beautiful wife, noble and endowed with beauty and virtue. (15)
O twice-born one, if Saturn and Rāhu are situated in the second house from Upārūḍha,
the abandonment or the loss of one's wife occurs due to slander.
When the second [sign] has ascended and Jupiter and Venus are situated therein,
his passionate wife will be afflicted by the disease of menorrhagia.
Then Mercury and Ketu were situated there together with the flow of bones;
Saturn, Mars, and the Sun, stationed there, were then afflicted by the fever of the bones.
O best of the twice-born,
if Mercury and Mars are situated there in the house of Mercury, the woman will have large limbs and be afflicted with diseases of the nose.
O best of the twice-born, the results in the Kujakṣetra should be understood to be exactly the same;
there, Jupiter and Saturn cause afflictions of the ears and eyes.
O Brahmin, when Mercury and Mars are situated in another's house,
and when the Moon and Jupiter [are likewise], the wife suffers from toothache.
If Saturn and Rāhu are in the sign of Saturn, the native will be lame or afflicted with wind-related diseases;
however, this result is not applicable if there is an aspect or conjunction with benefics—this is how the wise should understand it. (22)
O twice-born one, from the sign that is the seventh from the ascendant (lagna),
from its own lord, from the planet [occupying it], and from its degree, O best of the twice-born— (23).
"O Brahmin, Nārada and others have declared that the result should be understood in this very way when Saturn, the Moon, and Mercury are in the ninth house from those already mentioned. (24)
Likewise, sonlessness occurs through the Sun, Jupiter, and Rāhu; many sons through the Moon; with these mixed, there is one son; and with them combined, a son is born after a long delay. (25)
O Brahmin, by the conjunction of Ravi and Ījjarāhu, a son is born who possesses heroism and majesty,
is fiercely victorious, and is a subduer of enemies.
If [Saturn] is in the aforementioned place with Mars and Rahu, one is born without sons;
alternatively, one may have adopted sons or sons born together with the mother. || 27 ||
O best of the twice-born, when that [planet] is situated in an odd sign, a man is endowed with many daughters; when it is in an even sign, he has few offspring.
O Brahmin, if Leo is the ascendant and is conjoined with or aspected by the Moon,
one born in Virgo will have few offspring or will have daughters as children.

And because it possesses the portion of learning and cultivation, which brings about stability in the mental continuum, one should likewise contemplate the yoga in the three-part horoscope (triśāṃśakuṇḍalī) as well. (30)

Saturn and Rāhu, situated in the third or the eleventh house from the Pada, cause the destruction of the elder brother; in that case, they cause the destruction of the younger brother when situated in the eleventh or the third house respectively. (31)
If Jupiter is there, there is the destruction of the embryo, even if it is obstructed;
or if [the Moon] is in the ascendant or the eighth house, conjoined with or aspected by Venus.
O Brahmin, the lords of sages have declared without hesitation that the results are likewise for the third and eleventh houses; [and] for the Moon, Jupiter, Mercury, and Mars [in those positions].
O twice-born one, if [the Moon] is conjoined with or aspected by Saturn in the third or eleventh house, that person will have many brothers who are powerful and majestic.

O best of the twice-born, when Saturn alone is situated in the eleventh or the third house, O Brahmin, the destruction of the younger and the elder brothers should be known from the sky (the heavens). || 35 ||
Then he shall remain as the sole survivor while his other brothers perish;
if Ketu is in the third house, the place of gain, there will be abundant happiness from sisters.
If a malefic planet, devoid of benefic influence and lacking any connection with benefics, occupies the sixth house from the ascendant, the native becomes a thief. || 37 ||
O twice-born one, if the seventh or twelfth house is joined with or aspected by Rāhu,
the child will be wise and endowed with great fortune.
When the gentle Jupiter is situated in its exaltation, one becomes the sovereign of all lands;
therein, Jupiter makes one omniscient, Venus a poet, and Mercury an eloquent debater.
O best of the twice-born, if a benefic planet is situated in the second house from the ascendant or from the tenth house, one becomes wise and the lord of all wealth.
If the lord of the second house is ascendant-ascended and situated in the second house, conjoined with a malefic planet, one certainly becomes a thief. (41)
O twice-born one, if Rāhu is situated in the second house from the lord of the seventh house,
and Ketu is the planet [there], the child born will have prominent fangs and be stammering in speech.
If Saturn is in the second house from the lord of the seventh, one will be ugly;
if it is joined with mixed planets, one should predict a mixed result. (43)
The End of India
